verdict.rationale: Jira's features page explicitly claims pre-built and customizable templates for any project, from agile sprints to marketing campaigns, which directly matches jumpstarting a new project. Related claims of customizable fields, workflows and project-level configuration support tailoring a template after setup. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the template catalog and setup flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of template-based onboarding.
